They then make a few druidic markings on their torso, shoulders, and legs. On each leg are the markings for ‘honor’ and ‘death’. Above the subject’s heart is the marking for ‘life’ and on their stomach and below their collarbones are the markings for ‘memory’ and ‘future’. On each shoulder is the marking for ‘past’. Those important to the subject then drink the blood that flows out of the wounds. If going into a battle, only those who are not going into the same battle will drink of their blood. A special poultice is them applied to the wounds, allowing them to heal but scar intentionally.
    The next day, the subject of the ritual walks around stripped of as many of their clothes as possible, to show their ritual to be witnessed by those around them.
